scope: sandbox contract tests for machine.request-item-pickup / take-item-pickup-result
focused_command: taskset -c 0-5 nice -n 10 env CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=6 RAYON_NUM_THREADS=6 cargo test -p horizon-mods --features runtime,pack --test sandbox item_pickup -- --test-threads=1

checks: request is deferred and does not mutate the guest inventory snapshot
invalid handle and slot are rejected
wrong handle cannot complete another handle's request
first server completion wins; duplicate completion cannot replace the result
confirmed zero result remains a failure
removal revokes only the removed handle's pending pickup
old guest's pending request is invalid after reload
new guest reuses the local request id without inheriting old authority
completion from the old handle cannot complete the new request

full_sandbox_suite.command: taskset -c 0-5 nice -n 10 env CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=6 RAYON_NUM_THREADS=6 cargo test -p horizon-mods --features runtime,pack --test sandbox -- --test-threads=1

limits: CPU affinity 0-5, nice 10, Cargo jobs 6, Rayon 6; sandbox-generated hmods remain under target/mods-test.
